procedures.title: Neurological Reflexes in the Newborn
procedures.instructions: Examine the newborn baby for neurological reflexes. State each reflex, demonstrate the eliciting technique, and state the normal response and clinical significance.
procedures.scenario_prompt: You are stationed in the postnatal nursery. A full-term baby born 24 hours ago requires a complete neurological reflexes assessment prior to discharge. Conduct the examination, demonstrating each maneuver clearly and reporting your findings to the examiner.

items.description: Greet the examiner and introduce self
items.verification_criteria: Greet the examiner and introduce self

items.description: Explain procedure to the mother and gain consent
items.verification_criteria: Explain procedure to the mother and gain consent

items.description: Wash and dry hands thoroughly or perform hand hygiene
items.verification_criteria: Wash and dry hands thoroughly or perform hand hygiene

items.description: Ensure baby is in a warm, draft-free room with adequate lighting
items.verification_criteria: Ensure baby is in a warm, draft-free room with adequate lighting

items.description: Carry baby, wrap up with warm towel, and check reflexes one after another
items.verification_criteria: Carry baby, wrap up with warm towel, and check reflexes one after another

items.description: List the key primitive reflexes present in the newborn (Moro, rooting, sucking, swallowing, palmar, plantar, tonic neck, stepping, Babinski, cornea/blink)
items.verification_criteria: List the key primitive reflexes present in the newborn (Moro, rooting, sucking, swallowing, palmar, plantar, tonic neck, stepping, Babinski, cornea/blink)

items.description: Demonstrate Moro reflex: Hold infant at 45° angle, allow head to drop 1-2 cm gently; observe symmetric abduction, extension of arms, fanning of fingers followed by flexion
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Moro reflex: Hold infant at 45° angle, allow head to drop 1-2 cm gently; observe symmetric abduction, extension of arms, fanning of fingers followed by flexion

items.description: Demonstrate Rooting reflex: Stroke infant's cheek or corner of mouth; infant turns head toward stimulus and opens mouth to suck
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Rooting reflex: Stroke infant's cheek or corner of mouth; infant turns head toward stimulus and opens mouth to suck

items.description: Demonstrate Sucking and Swallowing reflex: Place clean gloved finger or nipple into infant's mouth; baby initiates strong, rhythmic sucking and swallows coordinated with breathing
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Sucking and Swallowing reflex: Place clean gloved finger or nipple into infant's mouth; baby initiates strong, rhythmic sucking and swallows coordinated with breathing

items.description: Demonstrate Palmar Grasp reflex: Place finger in palm from ulnar side; infant curls fingers around examiner's finger with firm grasp
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Palmar Grasp reflex: Place finger in palm from ulnar side; infant curls fingers around examiner's finger with firm grasp

items.description: Demonstrate Plantar Grasp reflex: Press thumb against ball of infant's foot; toes curl downward tightly
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Plantar Grasp reflex: Press thumb against ball of infant's foot; toes curl downward tightly

items.description: Demonstrate Asymmetric Tonic Neck Reflex (Fencing position): Turn infant's head to one side while supine; ipsilateral arm/leg extend, contralateral arm/leg flex
clinical_synonyms: arm on side head faces extends
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Asymmetric Tonic Neck Reflex (Fencing position): Turn infant's head to one side while supine; ipsilateral arm/leg extend, contralateral arm/leg flex

items.description: Demonstrate Babinski (Plantar) reflex: Stroke lateral aspect of sole from heel upward across ball of foot; hyperextension/dorsiflexion of great toe with fanning of other toes
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Babinski (Plantar) reflex: Stroke lateral aspect of sole from heel upward across ball of foot; hyperextension/dorsiflexion of great toe with fanning of other toes

items.description: Demonstrate Stepping / Walking reflex: Hold baby upright with feet touching flat surface; baby makes coordinated stepping movements
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Stepping / Walking reflex: Hold baby upright with feet touching flat surface; baby makes coordinated stepping movements

items.description: State clinical significance: Absence or asymmetry indicates CNS depression, birth trauma (e.g. brachial plexus palsy, clavicle fracture), or neurological impairment
items.verification_criteria: State clinical significance: Absence or asymmetry indicates CNS depression, birth trauma (e.g. brachial plexus palsy, clavicle fracture), or neurological impairment

items.description: Comfort and re-wrap baby warmly, place in safe position in cot
items.verification_criteria: Comfort and re-wrap baby warmly, place in safe position in cot

items.description: Wash hands and document procedure, reflexes elicited, and newborn neurological findings
items.verification_criteria: Wash hands and document procedure, reflexes elicited, and newborn neurological findings

procedures.title: Anatomy, Diameters and Sutures of the Foetal Skull
procedures.instructions: Using the model of the fetal skull and a pointer, demonstrate the regions, sutures, fontanelles, and state the longitudinal and transverse diameters with their measurements.
procedures.scenario_prompt: You are at Station 19 with a fetal skull model. The examiner asks you to demonstrate the anatomical areas, sutures, fontanelles, and describe all engaging diameters and their clinical significance in labor.

items.description: Greet the examiner, introduce self, and hold model of fetal skull correctly at eye level with both hands
items.verification_criteria: Greet the examiner, introduce self, and hold model of fetal skull correctly at eye level with both hands

items.description: Identify and describe the three anatomical regions of the skull: Vault, Face, and Base
items.verification_criteria: Identify and describe the three anatomical regions of the skull: Vault, Face, and Base

items.description: Identify the bones of the skull: 2 Frontal, 2 Parietal, 1 Occipital, and 2 Temporal bones
items.verification_criteria: Identify the bones of the skull: 2 Frontal, 2 Parietal, 1 Occipital, and 2 Temporal bones

items.description: Identify and demonstrate the four main sutures using the pointer: Frontal suture, Sagittal suture, Coronal suture, Lambdoidal suture
items.verification_criteria: Identify and demonstrate the four main sutures using the pointer: Frontal suture, Sagittal suture, Coronal suture, Lambdoidal suture

items.description: Demonstrate Anterior Fontanelle (Bregma): Diamond shaped, formed by junction of sagittal, frontal and coronal sutures, closes at 18 months
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Anterior Fontanelle (Bregma): Diamond shaped, formed by junction of sagittal, frontal and coronal sutures, closes at 18 months

items.description: Demonstrate Posterior Fontanelle (Lambda): Triangular shaped, formed by junction of sagittal and lambdoidal sutures, closes at 6-8 weeks
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Posterior Fontanelle (Lambda): Triangular shaped, formed by junction of sagittal and lambdoidal sutures, closes at 6-8 weeks

items.description: Demonstrate Suboccipito-Bregmatic diameter: Extends from nape of neck to center of bregma, measures 9.5 cm (presenting in fully flexed vertex)
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Suboccipito-Bregmatic diameter: Extends from nape of neck to center of bregma, measures 9.5 cm (presenting in fully flexed vertex)

items.description: Demonstrate Suboccipito-Frontal diameter: Extends from nape of neck to front of bregma, measures 10.0 cm (partially flexed vertex)
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Suboccipito-Frontal diameter: Extends from nape of neck to front of bregma, measures 10.0 cm (partially flexed vertex)

items.description: Demonstrate Occipito-Frontal diameter: Extends from occipital protuberance to glabella / root of nose, measures 11.5 cm (deflexed head)
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Occipito-Frontal diameter: Extends from occipital protuberance to glabella / root of nose, measures 11.5 cm (deflexed head)

items.description: Demonstrate Mento-Vertical diameter: Extends from tip of chin to highest point of vertex, measures 13.5 cm (brow presentation, cannot deliver vaginally)
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Mento-Vertical diameter: Extends from tip of chin to highest point of vertex, measures 13.5 cm (brow presentation, cannot deliver vaginally)

items.description: Demonstrate Submento-Bregmatic (9.5 cm) and Submento-Vertical (11.5 cm) diameters in face presentation
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate Submento-Bregmatic (9.5 cm) and Submento-Vertical (11.5 cm) diameters in face presentation

items.description: Demonstrate transverse diameters: Biparietal diameter (9.5 cm between parietal eminences) and Bitemporal diameter (8.2 cm between coronal suture ends)
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate transverse diameters: Biparietal diameter (9.5 cm between parietal eminences) and Bitemporal diameter (8.2 cm between coronal suture ends)

items.description: Explain moulding: Overlapping of cranial bones at sutures to reduce diameters for passage through the birth canal; conclude procedure
items.verification_criteria: Explain moulding: Overlapping of cranial bones at sutures to reduce diameters for passage through the birth canal; conclude procedure

procedures.title: Comprehensive Physical Examination of the Newborn
procedures.instructions: Perform a systematic head-to-toe physical examination of the newborn infant. Explain reasons, observe asepsis, describe each body system examined, and state normal and abnormal findings.
procedures.scenario_prompt: You are assigned to examine a newly delivered neonate. Perform a head-to-toe physical assessment while explaining your findings and clinical rationale to the examiner.

items.description: Greet examiner, introduce self, and explain procedure to mother to gain consent
items.verification_criteria: Greet examiner, introduce self, and explain procedure to mother to gain consent

items.description: State reasons for physical examination: assess extrauterine transition, detect congenital anomalies, and establish baseline health status
items.verification_criteria: State reasons for physical examination: assess extrauterine transition, detect congenital anomalies, and establish baseline health status

items.description: Perform hand hygiene, ensure warm draft-free room under radiant heater/light, and expose baby systematically
items.verification_criteria: Perform hand hygiene, ensure warm draft-free room under radiant heater/light, and expose baby systematically

items.description: Assess general appearance: posture (flexed), skin color (pink, absence of central cyanosis, jaundice or pallor), cry, muscle tone, and respiratory effort
items.verification_criteria: Assess general appearance: posture (flexed), skin color (pink, absence of central cyanosis, jaundice or pallor), cry, muscle tone, and respiratory effort

items.description: Examine Head: Check size, shape, moulding, caput succedaneum vs cephalhematoma; palpate anterior and posterior fontanelles and sutures
items.verification_criteria: Examine Head: Check size, shape, moulding, caput succedaneum vs cephalhematoma; palpate anterior and posterior fontanelles and sutures

items.description: Examine Face, Eyes, Ears, Nose: Check for dysmorphic features, subconjunctival haemorrhage, discharge, patent nares (no flaring), ear alignment and recoil
items.verification_criteria: Examine Face, Eyes, Ears, Nose: Check for dysmorphic features, subconjunctival haemorrhage, discharge, patent nares (no flaring), ear alignment and recoil

items.description: Examine Mouth: Inspect lips, gums, hard and soft palates using gloved finger/penlight to exclude cleft lip/palate, Epstein pearls, and assess sucking
items.verification_criteria: Examine Mouth: Inspect lips, gums, hard and soft palates using gloved finger/penlight to exclude cleft lip/palate, Epstein pearls, and assess sucking

items.description: Examine Neck, Chest and Heart: Palpate clavicles (exclude fracture), inspect chest symmetry, count respirations (30-60 bpm, no retractions), auscultate apical heart rate (120-160 bpm)
items.verification_criteria: Examine Neck, Chest and Heart: Palpate clavicles (exclude fracture), inspect chest symmetry, count respirations (30-60 bpm, no retractions), auscultate apical heart rate (120-160 bpm)

items.description: Examine Abdomen and Cord: Inspect contour (soft, slightly protuberant), palpate liver/spleen, inspect umbilical cord for 3 vessels (2 arteries, 1 vein) and no bleeding/discharge
items.verification_criteria: Examine Abdomen and Cord: Inspect contour (soft, slightly protuberant), palpate liver/spleen, inspect umbilical cord for 3 vessels (2 arteries, 1 vein) and no bleeding/discharge

items.description: Examine Genitalia and Anus: For male, check urethral meatus at tip, descended testes in scrotum, no hydrocele; for female, labia majora covering minora; check anal patency and meconium passage
items.verification_criteria: Examine Genitalia and Anus: For male, check urethral meatus at tip, descended testes in scrotum, no hydrocele; for female, labia majora covering minora; check anal patency and meconium passage

items.description: Examine Spine and Extremities: Inspect back/spine for spina bifida/sacral dimple; check limbs, count 10 fingers/toes (exclude polydactyly/syndactyly), check hip stability (Ortolani/Barlow test)
items.verification_criteria: Examine Spine and Extremities: Inspect back/spine for spina bifida/sacral dimple; check limbs, count 10 fingers/toes (exclude polydactyly/syndactyly), check hip stability (Ortolani/Barlow test)

items.description: Dress and swaddle baby warmly, return to mother, wash hands, and document all findings in newborn examination chart
items.verification_criteria: Dress and swaddle baby warmly, return to mother, wash hands, and document all findings in newborn examination chart

procedures.title: Resuscitation of the Newborn by Face Mask Ventilation
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate immediate neonatal resuscitation using a bag and face mask on the newborn mannequin. Follow Helping Babies Breathe (HBB) / NRP guidelines within the Golden Minute.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A neonate has just been delivered apnoic and limp with thick meconium-stained amniotic fluid. You must initiate immediate resuscitation within the Golden Minute. Demonstrate your actions and report to the examiner.
equipment_list: Self-inflating bag (250-500ml) with pressure release valve

items.description: Ensure adequate lighting and warmth in the delivery room; start the clock/timer immediately upon delivery
items.verification_criteria: Ensure adequate lighting and warmth in the delivery room; start the clock/timer immediately upon delivery

items.description: Assess APGAR / initial vitality: breathing/crying, heart rate, and muscle tone within the first seconds
items.verification_criteria: Assess APGAR / initial vitality: breathing/crying, heart rate, and muscle tone within the first seconds

items.description: Transfer baby to pre-warmed resuscitaire; dry baby quickly and thoroughly from head to toe, removing wet linen
items.verification_criteria: Transfer baby to pre-warmed resuscitaire; dry baby quickly and thoroughly from head to toe, removing wet linen

items.description: Position baby with neck slightly extended in sniffing position by placing a small shoulder roll (towel) under shoulders
items.verification_criteria: Position baby with neck slightly extended in sniffing position by placing a small shoulder roll (towel) under shoulders

items.description: Clear upper airway: Gentle suctioning of mouth first, then nose (M before N) using suction bulb or catheter (depth not exceeding 2 cm / 2 inches)
items.verification_criteria: Clear upper airway: Gentle suctioning of mouth first, then nose (M before N) using suction bulb or catheter (depth not exceeding 2 cm / 2 inches)

items.description: Stimulate breathing by gently rubbing baby's back or flicking the soles of the feet (maximum twice)
items.verification_criteria: Stimulate breathing by gently rubbing baby's back or flicking the soles of the feet (maximum twice)

items.description: Re-evaluate within 30 seconds: If baby remains gasping, apnoic, or HR < 100 bpm, initiate Positive Pressure Ventilation (PPV) immediately within Golden Minute
items.verification_criteria: Re-evaluate within 30 seconds: If baby remains gasping, apnoic, or HR < 100 bpm, initiate Positive Pressure Ventilation (PPV) immediately within Golden Minute

items.description: Select correct mask size (size 1 for term, size 0 for preterm) covering mouth, nose, and chin without covering eyes
items.verification_criteria: Select correct mask size (size 1 for term, size 0 for preterm) covering mouth, nose, and chin without covering eyes

items.description: Apply mask using C-E grip with thumb and index finger holding mask and remaining three fingers lifting mandible upward into mask to create airtight seal
items.verification_criteria: Apply mask using C-E grip with thumb and index finger holding mask and remaining three fingers lifting mandible upward into mask to create airtight seal

items.description: Ventilate at a rate of 40-60 breaths per minute, calling cadence: 'Squeeze, two, three, squeeze, two, three'
items.verification_criteria: Ventilate at a rate of 40-60 breaths per minute, calling cadence: 'Squeeze, two, three, squeeze, two, three'

items.description: Check chest rise: If chest is not rising, perform ventilation corrective steps (MRSOPA: Mask readjust, Reposition airway, Suction mouth/nose, Open mouth, Pressure increase, Alternative airway)
items.verification_criteria: Check chest rise: If chest is not rising, perform ventilation corrective steps (MRSOPA: Mask readjust, Reposition airway, Suction mouth/nose, Open mouth, Pressure increase, Alternative airway)

items.description: Auscultate heart rate after 30 seconds of effective ventilation: If HR > 100 bpm and baby breathes spontaneously, gradually discontinue PPV and provide supportive care
items.verification_criteria: Auscultate heart rate after 30 seconds of effective ventilation: If HR > 100 bpm and baby breathes spontaneously, gradually discontinue PPV and provide supportive care

items.description: Keep infant warm (skin-to-skin or incubator), document resuscitation steps, duration, APGAR scores, and notify pediatrician/NICU
items.verification_criteria: Keep infant warm (skin-to-skin or incubator), document resuscitation steps, duration, APGAR scores, and notify pediatrician/NICU

procedures.title: Insertion of Nasogastric (NG) Tube
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate the complete procedure for inserting a nasogastric tube into an adult patient model. Observe sterile technique, measurement, insertion technique, placement verification, and documentation.
procedures.scenario_prompt: You are ordered to insert a nasogastric tube for decompression and enteral feeding for an adult patient. Carry out the procedure on the mannequin model and explain each step to the examiner.

items.description: Identify the patient correctly using two identifiers, check physician's order, and explain procedure to reduce anxiety and gain consent
items.verification_criteria: Identify the patient correctly using two identifiers, check physician's order, and explain procedure to reduce anxiety and gain consent

items.description: Perform hand hygiene and assemble all required equipment neatly on a sterile tray / trolley
items.verification_criteria: Perform hand hygiene and assemble all required equipment neatly on a sterile tray / trolley

items.description: Position patient in high Fowler's position (or sitting upright at 45-90°) with pillow behind head and shoulders; place protective towel across chest
items.verification_criteria: Position patient in high Fowler's position (or sitting upright at 45-90°) with pillow behind head and shoulders; place protective towel across chest

items.description: Assess patency of nares: Ask patient to occlude one nostril and breathe through the other; select nostril with greater airflow
items.verification_criteria: Assess patency of nares: Ask patient to occlude one nostril and breathe through the other; select nostril with greater airflow

items.description: Measure tube length accurately using NEX method: From tip of Nose to Earlobe, then from Earlobe to Xiphoid process; mark distance with adhesive tape
items.verification_criteria: Measure tube length accurately using NEX method: From tip of Nose to Earlobe, then from Earlobe to Xiphoid process; mark distance with adhesive tape

items.description: Put on clean gloves and lubricate first 7.5 to 10 cm (3-4 inches) of tube tip with water-soluble lubricant
items.verification_criteria: Put on clean gloves and lubricate first 7.5 to 10 cm (3-4 inches) of tube tip with water-soluble lubricant

items.description: Instruct patient to tilt head back slightly; gently insert tube into selected nostril advancing along nasal floor towards ear until posterior pharynx is reached
items.verification_criteria: Instruct patient to tilt head back slightly; gently insert tube into selected nostril advancing along nasal floor towards ear until posterior pharynx is reached

items.description: When tube reaches pharynx, instruct patient to tilt head forward (chin to chest) and swallow sips of water (or dry swallow); advance tube 5-10 cm with each swallow
items.verification_criteria: When tube reaches pharynx, instruct patient to tilt head forward (chin to chest) and swallow sips of water (or dry swallow); advance tube 5-10 cm with each swallow

items.description: If patient coughs, chokes, becomes cyanotic or cannot speak, stop immediately, pull tube back into pharynx and let patient rest (prevents tracheal entry)
items.verification_criteria: If patient coughs, chokes, becomes cyanotic or cannot speak, stop immediately, pull tube back into pharynx and let patient rest (prevents tracheal entry)

items.description: Advance tube until previously marked tape indicator reaches patient's nostril
items.verification_criteria: Advance tube until previously marked tape indicator reaches patient's nostril

items.description: Verify tube placement: Aspirate gastric contents with syringe and check pH using litmus paper (pH ≤ 5.5 confirms gastric placement) AND auscultate whoosh sound over epigastrium while injecting 10-20ml air
items.verification_criteria: Verify tube placement: Aspirate gastric contents with syringe and check pH using litmus paper (pH ≤ 5.5 confirms gastric placement) AND auscultate whoosh sound over epigastrium while injecting 10-20ml air

items.description: Secure tube to nose using split adhesive tape / fixation device without pressing on nostril tissue, and clip tube to patient's gown
items.verification_criteria: Secure tube to nose using split adhesive tape / fixation device without pressing on nostril tissue, and clip tube to patient's gown

items.description: Clean patient's face, remove gloves, wash hands, and document date, time, tube type/size, insertion distance, verification method, and aspirate characteristics
items.verification_criteria: Clean patient's face, remove gloves, wash hands, and document date, time, tube type/size, insertion distance, verification method, and aspirate characteristics

procedures.title: Clinical Hand Washing and Hand Hygiene Technique
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate the WHO 6-step medical hand hygiene procedure using running water and soap. Explain the importance of infection prevention and each step.
procedures.scenario_prompt: You are entering the surgical ward to care for a patient. Demonstrate the proper medical hand washing procedure at the sink, verbalizing each step to the examiner.

items.description: Candidate greets examiner, introduces self, and explains rationale: prevent cross-contamination and hospital-acquired infections
items.verification_criteria: Candidate greets examiner, introduces self, and explains rationale: prevent cross-contamination and hospital-acquired infections

items.description: Remove rings, wristwatch and roll up sleeves above elbows; stand away from sink so clothes do not touch sink edges
items.verification_criteria: Remove rings, wristwatch and roll up sleeves above elbows; stand away from sink so clothes do not touch sink edges

items.description: Turn on tap, wet hands with clean water thoroughly and apply sufficient liquid soap (coin size / 3-5ml) to cover all hand surfaces
items.verification_criteria: Turn on tap, wet hands with clean water thoroughly and apply sufficient liquid soap (coin size / 3-5ml) to cover all hand surfaces

items.description: Step 1: Rub hands palm to palm in a circular motion
items.verification_criteria: Step 1: Rub hands palm to palm in a circular motion

items.description: Step 2: Rub right palm over left dorsum with interlaced fingers, and vice versa
items.verification_criteria: Step 2: Rub right palm over left dorsum with interlaced fingers, and vice versa

items.description: Step 3: Rub palm to palm with fingers interlaced
clinical_synonyms: palm to palm with fingers interlaced
items.verification_criteria: Step 3: Rub palm to palm with fingers interlaced

items.description: Step 4: Rub backs of fingers to opposing palms with fingers interlocked
clinical_synonyms: backs of fingers to opposing palms
items.verification_criteria: Step 4: Rub backs of fingers to opposing palms with fingers interlocked

items.description: Step 5: Rotational rubbing of left thumb clasped in right palm, and vice versa
items.verification_criteria: Step 5: Rotational rubbing of left thumb clasped in right palm, and vice versa

items.description: Step 6: Rotational rubbing backwards and forwards with clasped fingers of right hand in left palm, and vice versa
items.verification_criteria: Step 6: Rotational rubbing backwards and forwards with clasped fingers of right hand in left palm, and vice versa

items.description: Rinse hands thoroughly under running water keeping hands lower than elbows so contaminated water drains off fingertips
items.verification_criteria: Rinse hands thoroughly under running water keeping hands lower than elbows so contaminated water drains off fingertips

items.description: Dry hands completely with single-use paper towel from fingers to wrists; use paper towel / elbow to turn off tap without recontaminating hands
clinical_synonyms: turn off tap with paper towel
items.verification_criteria: Dry hands completely with single-use paper towel from fingers to wrists; use paper towel / elbow to turn off tap without recontaminating hands

procedures.title: Preparation of an Unoccupied Hospital Bed
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate the complete method for stripping and making an unoccupied hospital bed. Observe ergonomics, hygiene, tight mitered corners, and neat finished bed.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A patient has been discharged and the bed has been sanitized. Prepare a clean, unoccupied closed bed ready for a new admission following nursing principles.

items.description: Greet examiner, explain procedure, wash and dry hands, and assemble clean linen in reverse order of use on two chairs at foot of bed
items.verification_criteria: Greet examiner, explain procedure, wash and dry hands, and assemble clean linen in reverse order of use on two chairs at foot of bed

items.description: Check bed height, adjust to comfortable working height, switch off fan to prevent air current dispersal of organisms
items.verification_criteria: Check bed height, adjust to comfortable working height, switch off fan to prevent air current dispersal of organisms

items.description: Strip soiled linen: Remove pillow and place on chair, strip each sheet from head to foot, roll inward without shaking, place in laundry bag
items.verification_criteria: Strip soiled linen: Remove pillow and place on chair, strip each sheet from head to foot, roll inward without shaking, place in laundry bag

items.description: Inspect mattress: Clean/carbolize mattress if required and turn mattress according to ward protocol
items.verification_criteria: Inspect mattress: Clean/carbolize mattress if required and turn mattress according to ward protocol

items.description: Place clean bottom sheet right side up, align center fold along midline of mattress, unfold evenly leaving sufficient overhang at head end
items.verification_criteria: Place clean bottom sheet right side up, align center fold along midline of mattress, unfold evenly leaving sufficient overhang at head end

items.description: Tuck bottom sheet firmly under mattress at head end and make a neat mitred (envelope) corner; tuck along the side
items.verification_criteria: Tuck bottom sheet firmly under mattress at head end and make a neat mitred (envelope) corner; tuck along the side

items.description: Place mackintosh (waterproof sheet) across middle third of bed, tuck tightly under mattress
items.verification_criteria: Place mackintosh (waterproof sheet) across middle third of bed, tuck tightly under mattress

items.description: Place cotton draw sheet over mackintosh covering it completely (5 cm wider), tuck tightly under mattress on near side
items.verification_criteria: Place cotton draw sheet over mackintosh covering it completely (5 cm wider), tuck tightly under mattress on near side

items.description: Move to opposite side of bed: Tuck bottom sheet, make mitred corner at head end, pull mackintosh and draw sheet firmly to remove all wrinkles, tuck tightly
items.verification_criteria: Move to opposite side of bed: Tuck bottom sheet, make mitred corner at head end, pull mackintosh and draw sheet firmly to remove all wrinkles, tuck tightly

items.description: Place top sheet wrong side up with center fold in middle, tuck at foot end and make mitred corner at bottom; place blanket and bedspread
items.verification_criteria: Place top sheet wrong side up with center fold in middle, tuck at foot end and make mitred corner at bottom; place blanket and bedspread

items.description: Fold top sheet back over blanket/bedspread at head end to make neat 15-20 cm cuff
items.verification_criteria: Fold top sheet back over blanket/bedspread at head end to make neat 15-20 cm cuff

items.description: Fit clean pillowcase onto pillow without touching uniform; place pillow on bed with opening away from the ward entrance
items.verification_criteria: Fit clean pillowcase onto pillow without touching uniform; place pillow on bed with opening away from the ward entrance

items.description: Tidy room, reposition bed to lowest height, wash hands, and document bed making completion
items.verification_criteria: Tidy room, reposition bed to lowest height, wash hands, and document bed making completion

procedures.title: Bathing of the Vulva and Perineal Area (Perineal Toilet)
procedures.session_label: Professional Examination for General Nurses - November 2012
procedures.instructions: Perform perineal toilet/swabbing on a postnatal/gynaecological patient model. Observe aseptic technique, proper direction of swabbing, client dignity and comfort.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A patient on the postnatal ward who had a normal vaginal delivery with a repaired second-degree tear requires perineal toilet. Demonstrate the aseptic procedure on the model.
equipment_list: Sterile dressing pack (swabs/cotton balls, gallipots, dissecting forceps, receiver)

items.description: Greet patient, introduce self, verify patient identity, and explain procedure to reduce apprehension and secure cooperation
items.verification_criteria: Greet patient, introduce self, verify patient identity, and explain procedure to reduce apprehension and secure cooperation

items.description: Screen the bed to provide privacy, close nearby windows and switch off fan to avoid drafts
items.verification_criteria: Screen the bed to provide privacy, close nearby windows and switch off fan to avoid drafts

items.description: Wash hands, assemble sterile equipment on top shelf of trolley and clean equipment on bottom shelf
items.verification_criteria: Wash hands, assemble sterile equipment on top shelf of trolley and clean equipment on bottom shelf

items.description: Position patient in dorsal recumbent position with knees flexed and thighs abducted; place mackintosh and bedpan under buttocks

items.description: Dry the area using sterile dry cotton swabs in the same sequence; apply sterile perineal pad from front to back

procedures.title: Administration of an Evacuant Enema
procedures.session_label: Professional Examination for General Nurses - May 2019
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate the preparation and administration of an evacuant enema on a medical/surgical training mannequin. Observe correct patient positioning, temperature, height of can, insertion technique, and aftercare.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A patient scheduled for pelvic surgery has an order for a cleansing soap-suds enema. Demonstrate the procedure on the mannequin model and answer the examiner's questions.
equipment_list: Enema can with rubber tubing, clamp and rectal tube (size 22-26 Fr)
Warm enema solution (soap suds or saline, 500-1000ml at 38-40°C)

items.description: Identify patient, check doctor's prescription, explain procedure, reassure patient and obtain consent
items.verification_criteria: Identify patient, check doctor's prescription, explain procedure, reassure patient and obtain consent

items.description: Provide privacy by screening the bed; ensure toilet or bedpan is readily available nearby
items.verification_criteria: Provide privacy by screening the bed; ensure toilet or bedpan is readily available nearby

items.description: Wash hands, don clean gloves, and prepare prescribed solution at appropriate temperature (38°C - 40°C / warm to inner wrist)
items.verification_criteria: Wash hands, don clean gloves, and prepare prescribed solution at appropriate temperature (38°C - 40°C / warm to inner wrist)

items.description: Position patient in Left Lateral (Sims') position with right knee and hip flexed; place protective mackintosh under buttocks
items.verification_criteria: Position patient in Left Lateral (Sims') position with right knee and hip flexed; place protective mackintosh under buttocks

items.description: Fill enema can, connect tubing and rectal tube; open clamp to prime tubing and expel all air into a receiver, then clamp tubing
items.verification_criteria: Fill enema can, connect tubing and rectal tube; open clamp to prime tubing and expel all air into a receiver, then clamp tubing

items.description: Hang enema can on IV stand 30 to 45 cm (12 to 18 inches) above patient's anus to ensure gentle gravity flow
items.verification_criteria: Hang enema can on IV stand 30 to 45 cm (12 to 18 inches) above patient's anus to ensure gentle gravity flow

items.description: Lubricate the distal 7.5 to 10 cm (3 to 4 inches) of the rectal tube with water-soluble lubricant
items.verification_criteria: Lubricate the distal 7.5 to 10 cm (3 to 4 inches) of the rectal tube with water-soluble lubricant

items.description: Expose only the anal area; instruct patient to breathe slowly through mouth to relax anal sphincters
items.verification_criteria: Expose only the anal area; instruct patient to breathe slowly through mouth to relax anal sphincters

items.description: Gently insert rectal tube 7.5 to 10 cm into rectum pointing towards the umbilicus; never force against resistance
items.verification_criteria: Gently insert rectal tube 7.5 to 10 cm into rectum pointing towards the umbilicus; never force against resistance

items.description: Unclamp tubing and allow solution to flow slowly over 10-15 minutes; if patient complains of cramping, clamp temporarily or lower can
items.verification_criteria: Unclamp tubing and allow solution to flow slowly over 10-15 minutes; if patient complains of cramping, clamp temporarily or lower can

items.description: When desired volume has run in, clamp tubing; withdraw rectal tube smoothly through toilet paper and place in receiver
items.verification_criteria: When desired volume has run in, clamp tubing; withdraw rectal tube smoothly through toilet paper and place in receiver

items.description: Encourage patient to retain solution for 5 to 10 minutes (or as long as possible); assist onto bedpan or commode when ready
items.verification_criteria: Encourage patient to retain solution for 5 to 10 minutes (or as long as possible); assist onto bedpan or commode when ready

items.description: Clean patient, remove equipment, wash hands, and document time, solution type, volume, return outcome, and patient tolerance
items.verification_criteria: Clean patient, remove equipment, wash hands, and document time, solution type, volume, return outcome, and patient tolerance

procedures.title: Taking General, Personal, Family and Social Health History
procedures.instructions: Take a comprehensive clinical health history from a simulated standardized patient. Cover biographical data, chief complaint, history of present illness, past medical/surgical history, family history, and personal/social history using effective communication skills.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A 32-year-old client is admitted to the medical clinic. Conduct a thorough initial nursing health history interview, recording data systematically while maintaining rapport and active listening.

items.description: Greet client warmly, introduce self, explain purpose of interview, ensure confidentiality, and create comfortable environment
items.verification_criteria: Greet client warmly, introduce self, explain purpose of interview, ensure confidentiality, and create comfortable environment

items.description: Obtain Biographical data: Full name, age, gender, marital status, address, telephone, next of kin, occupation, religion
items.verification_criteria: Obtain Biographical data: Full name, age, gender, marital status, address, telephone, next of kin, occupation, religion

items.description: Elicit Chief Complaint (Reason for visit) in the client's own words with duration
items.verification_criteria: Elicit Chief Complaint (Reason for visit) in the client's own words with duration

items.description: Explore History of Present Illness (HPI) using SOCRATES / PQRST: Onset, Location, Duration, Character, Aggravating/relieving factors, Radiation, Timing, Severity
items.verification_criteria: Explore History of Present Illness (HPI) using SOCRATES / PQRST: Onset, Location, Duration, Character, Aggravating/relieving factors, Radiation, Timing, Severity

items.description: Inquire about Past Medical History: Childhood illnesses, major adult medical conditions (hypertension, diabetes, asthma, sickle cell), previous hospitalizations
items.verification_criteria: Inquire about Past Medical History: Childhood illnesses, major adult medical conditions (hypertension, diabetes, asthma, sickle cell), previous hospitalizations

items.description: Inquire about Past Surgical and Obstetric History: Previous operations, blood transfusions, pregnancies, parity, deliveries, complications
items.verification_criteria: Inquire about Past Surgical and Obstetric History: Previous operations, blood transfusions, pregnancies, parity, deliveries, complications

items.description: Ask about Current Medications and Allergies: Prescription drugs, over-the-counter herbs, drug allergies (penicillin, sulfa), food/environmental allergies
items.verification_criteria: Ask about Current Medications and Allergies: Prescription drugs, over-the-counter herbs, drug allergies (penicillin, sulfa), food/environmental allergies

items.description: Take Family History: Familial diseases in parents/siblings (hypertension, diabetes, sickle cell trait/disease, twin gestation, cancer)
items.verification_criteria: Take Family History: Familial diseases in parents/siblings (hypertension, diabetes, sickle cell trait/disease, twin gestation, cancer)

items.description: Take Personal and Social History: Educational background, living conditions, water supply, dietary habits, alcohol intake, cigarette/tobacco use, exercise, stress
items.verification_criteria: Take Personal and Social History: Educational background, living conditions, water supply, dietary habits, alcohol intake, cigarette/tobacco use, exercise, stress

items.description: Perform Brief Review of Systems (ROS): General (fever, weight loss), respiratory (cough), cardiovascular (palpitations, chest pain), GI (nausea, bowel habits), urinary
items.verification_criteria: Perform Brief Review of Systems (ROS): General (fever, weight loss), respiratory (cough), cardiovascular (palpitations, chest pain), GI (nausea, bowel habits), urinary

items.description: Demonstrate active listening: Maintain eye contact, nod appropriately, summarize findings with client for verification, thank client
items.verification_criteria: Demonstrate active listening: Maintain eye contact, nod appropriately, summarize findings with client for verification, thank client

procedures.title: Aseptic Surgical Wound Dressing
procedures.instructions: Perform an aseptic surgical wound dressing on a postoperative abdominal wound model. Observe strict surgical asepsis, sterile field maintenance, wound assessment, and proper waste segregation.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A patient on Day 3 following an emergency Caesarean section requires an aseptic wound dressing change. The wound is clean with sutures in place. Carry out the procedure following surgical asepsis.
equipment_list: Sterile dressing pack (gauze swabs, cotton balls, dissecting forceps, tissue forceps, sterile drape, receiver)
Clinical waste bag (yellow) and domestic waste bag (black)

items.description: Greet patient, introduce self, verify patient identity, explain procedure, check for pain/allergies, and screen bed for privacy
items.verification_criteria: Greet patient, introduce self, verify patient identity, explain procedure, check for pain/allergies, and screen bed for privacy

items.description: Clean and decontaminate dressing trolley from top to bottom with 70% alcohol; wash hands and gather sterile supplies
items.verification_criteria: Clean and decontaminate dressing trolley from top to bottom with 70% alcohol; wash hands and gather sterile supplies

items.description: Expose wound area, position patient comfortably, place protective mackintosh under wound site, and position waste receiver nearby
items.verification_criteria: Expose wound area, position patient comfortably, place protective mackintosh under wound site, and position waste receiver nearby

items.description: Wash hands, open sterile dressing pack maintaining sterile borders; pour sterile 0.9% normal saline into sterile gallipot
items.verification_criteria: Wash hands, open sterile dressing pack maintaining sterile borders; pour sterile 0.9% normal saline into sterile gallipot

items.description: Don clean gloves to gently remove soiled dressing by peeling tape towards the wound to avoid traction; inspect soiled dressing for exudate, odor, amount
items.verification_criteria: Don clean gloves to gently remove soiled dressing by peeling tape towards the wound to avoid traction; inspect soiled dressing for exudate, odor, amount

items.description: Discard soiled dressing into yellow clinical waste bin, remove clean gloves, perform hand hygiene, and don sterile gloves (or use forceps)
items.verification_criteria: Discard soiled dressing into yellow clinical waste bin, remove clean gloves, perform hand hygiene, and don sterile gloves (or use forceps)

items.description: Inspect surgical wound: Assess incision length, edges approximation, signs of infection (erythema, edema, warmth, tenderness), and suture/staple integrity
items.verification_criteria: Inspect surgical wound: Assess incision length, edges approximation, signs of infection (erythema, edema, warmth, tenderness), and suture/staple integrity

items.description: Clean wound using sterile forceps and saline-soaked swabs: First stroke down the center along the incision line from top to bottom in one stroke; discard swab
items.verification_criteria: Clean wound using sterile forceps and saline-soaked swabs: First stroke down the center along the incision line from top to bottom in one stroke; discard swab

items.description: Clean wound side 1 (far side) from top to bottom using fresh swab; discard swab. Clean wound side 2 (near side) from top to bottom using fresh swab; discard swab
items.verification_criteria: Clean wound side 1 (far side) from top to bottom using fresh swab; discard swab. Clean wound side 2 (near side) from top to bottom using fresh swab; discard swab

items.description: Dry the wound gently using sterile dry gauze swabs in the same order; apply sterile dressing pads covering incision with 2.5 cm margin
items.verification_criteria: Dry the wound gently using sterile dry gauze swabs in the same order; apply sterile dressing pads covering incision with 2.5 cm margin

items.description: Secure dressing with hypoallergenic tape (Micropore), remove gloves, dispose of waste, make patient comfortable
items.verification_criteria: Secure dressing with hypoallergenic tape (Micropore), remove gloves, dispose of waste, make patient comfortable

items.description: Wash hands and document dressing change, wound appearance, drainage, healing progress, and patient reaction in nursing notes
items.verification_criteria: Wash hands and document dressing change, wound appearance, drainage, healing progress, and patient reaction in nursing notes

procedures.title: Nutrition: Food Group Identification and Dietary Counseling
procedures.instructions: Identify the food specimens displayed (Specimens A, B, C, D). Classify each into its nutrient group, state its biological function, and provide nutritional counseling for a malnourished or convalescent patient.
procedures.scenario_prompt: Four food specimens are displayed before you: Specimen A (Rice/Grains), Specimen B (Fish/Beans), Specimen C (Palm oil/Groundnut oil), Specimen D (Spinach/Citrus fruits). Identify, classify, and counsel a mother on balanced diet.

items.description: Greet examiner, introduce self, and identify the four food specimens accurately
items.verification_criteria: Greet examiner, introduce self, and identify the four food specimens accurately

items.description: Classify Specimen A (Rice/Yam/Maize): Carbohydrate (Energy-giving food); function: provides glucose for cellular energy and bodily functions
items.verification_criteria: Classify Specimen A (Rice/Yam/Maize): Carbohydrate (Energy-giving food); function: provides glucose for cellular energy and bodily functions

items.description: Classify Specimen B (Fish/Meat/Beans): Protein (Body-building food); function: growth, tissue repair, enzyme and antibody synthesis
items.verification_criteria: Classify Specimen B (Fish/Meat/Beans): Protein (Body-building food); function: growth, tissue repair, enzyme and antibody synthesis

items.description: Classify Specimen C (Palm oil/Groundnut oil): Lipids/Fats; function: concentrated energy source, cell membrane structure, absorption of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K)
items.verification_criteria: Classify Specimen C (Palm oil/Groundnut oil): Lipids/Fats; function: concentrated energy source, cell membrane structure, absorption of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K)

items.description: Classify Specimen D (Green leafy vegetables / Fruits): Vitamins and Minerals (Protective food); function: immunity, wound healing, bone density, regulation of metabolic processes
items.verification_criteria: Classify Specimen D (Green leafy vegetables / Fruits): Vitamins and Minerals (Protective food); function: immunity, wound healing, bone density, regulation of metabolic processes

items.description: Define a balanced diet: A diet containing all six food classes in correct proportions according to age, sex, activity, and physiological state
items.verification_criteria: Define a balanced diet: A diet containing all six food classes in correct proportions according to age, sex, activity, and physiological state

items.description: Provide practical dietary counseling: Use locally available and affordable foods (four-star diet: staples, legumes, animal-source foods, fruits/vegetables) for family and child feeding
items.verification_criteria: Provide practical dietary counseling: Use locally available and affordable foods (four-star diet: staples, legumes, animal-source foods, fruits/vegetables) for family and child feeding

procedures.title: Administration of Intramuscular Injection (Gluteal Route)
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate the preparation and administration of an intramuscular injection via the gluteal route on an injection mannequin model. Follow the 'Five Rights' of medication administration, aseptic technique, site landmarking, aspiration, and sharps disposal.
procedures.scenario_prompt: An adult patient is prescribed Ampicillin 500mg IM stat. Demonstrate the complete preparation, site identification (dorsogluteal/ventrogluteal), injection technique, and aftercare.

items.description: Check prescription order: Verify the Five Rights (Right Patient, Right Drug, Right Dose, Right Route, Right Time) and check expiry date
clinical_synonyms: right patient drug dose route time
items.verification_criteria: Check prescription order: Verify the Five Rights (Right Patient, Right Drug, Right Dose, Right Route, Right Time) and check expiry date

items.description: Greet patient, introduce self, verify identity with two identifiers, explain procedure, check for allergies, and gain consent
items.verification_criteria: Greet patient, introduce self, verify identity with two identifiers, explain procedure, check for allergies, and gain consent

items.description: Perform hand hygiene, assemble medication, syringe, needle, alcohol swabs, and clean injection tray
items.verification_criteria: Perform hand hygiene, assemble medication, syringe, needle, alcohol swabs, and clean injection tray

items.description: Draw up medication aseptically: Disinfect vial top / snap ampoule with gauze, draw correct dose, expel air bubbles, replace with injection needle
items.verification_criteria: Draw up medication aseptically: Disinfect vial top / snap ampoule with gauze, draw correct dose, expel air bubbles, replace with injection needle

items.description: Position patient comfortably in prone position with toes pointed inward (or lateral position with flexed knee) to relax gluteal muscles
items.verification_criteria: Position patient comfortably in prone position with toes pointed inward (or lateral position with flexed knee) to relax gluteal muscles

items.description: Landmark the injection site accurately: For Dorsogluteal, divide buttock into four quadrants and select upper outer quadrant (above line from PSIS to greater trochanter) to avoid sciatic nerve; OR landmark Ventrogluteal site
items.verification_criteria: Landmark the injection site accurately: For Dorsogluteal, divide buttock into four quadrants and select upper outer quadrant (above line from PSIS to greater trochanter) to avoid sciatic nerve; OR landmark Ventrogluteal site

items.description: Don clean gloves; cleanse injection site with 70% alcohol swab in a circular motion from center outwards (5 cm diameter); allow to air-dry completely (30 seconds)
items.verification_criteria: Don clean gloves; cleanse injection site with 70% alcohol swab in a circular motion from center outwards (5 cm diameter); allow to air-dry completely (30 seconds)

items.description: Spread skin taut with non-dominant hand (or Z-track technique); hold syringe like a dart at 90-degree angle to skin surface
items.verification_criteria: Spread skin taut with non-dominant hand (or Z-track technique); hold syringe like a dart at 90-degree angle to skin surface

items.description: Insert needle smoothly and firmly into the muscle using a quick darting motion, leaving 1/3 of needle shaft visible
items.verification_criteria: Insert needle smoothly and firmly into the muscle using a quick darting motion, leaving 1/3 of needle shaft visible

items.description: Aspirate: Pull back plunger gently for 5-10 seconds; check for blood return. If blood appears, withdraw needle, discard, and restart. If no blood, proceed
items.verification_criteria: Aspirate: Pull back plunger gently for 5-10 seconds; check for blood return. If blood appears, withdraw needle, discard, and restart. If no blood, proceed

items.description: Inject medication slowly at a rate of 1 ml per 10 seconds to allow muscle fibers to stretch and reduce pain; wait 10 seconds before withdrawal
items.verification_criteria: Inject medication slowly at a rate of 1 ml per 10 seconds to allow muscle fibers to stretch and reduce pain; wait 10 seconds before withdrawal

items.description: Withdraw needle smoothly at same 90° angle while applying dry sterile cotton ball with gentle pressure; do not massage site
items.verification_criteria: Withdraw needle smoothly at same 90° angle while applying dry sterile cotton ball with gentle pressure; do not massage site

items.description: Dispose needle immediately into puncture-proof sharps box without recapping; remove gloves, wash hands, and document in MAR
items.verification_criteria: Dispose needle immediately into puncture-proof sharps box without recapping; remove gloves, wash hands, and document in MAR

procedures.title: Application of Figure-of-Eight Bandage (Ankle/Joint)
procedures.instructions: Apply a figure-of-eight roller bandage to a client presenting with a sprained ankle or wrist. Ensure correct tension, direction, heel coverage, and distal neurovascular assessment.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A client presents with an inversion sprain of the right ankle. Apply a supportive figure-of-eight bandage to immobilize and reduce edema, demonstrating proper bandaging principles.

items.description: Greet patient, introduce self, explain procedure, inspect injured joint, and check distal pulse and skin warmth
items.verification_criteria: Greet patient, introduce self, explain procedure, inspect injured joint, and check distal pulse and skin warmth

items.description: Position patient comfortably with leg extended and ankle supported at 90-degree functional flexion (dorsiflexion)
items.verification_criteria: Position patient comfortably with leg extended and ankle supported at 90-degree functional flexion (dorsiflexion)

items.description: Hold bandage roll correctly: Head (roll) uppermost and tail underneath facing the limb
items.verification_criteria: Hold bandage roll correctly: Head (roll) uppermost and tail underneath facing the limb

items.description: Anchor bandage with two circular turns around the ball of the foot (metatarsal heads) moving from medial to lateral
items.verification_criteria: Anchor bandage with two circular turns around the ball of the foot (metatarsal heads) moving from medial to lateral

items.description: Carry bandage obliquely across dorsum of foot, around back of ankle joint above malleoli, and cross back over dorsum of foot to opposite side
items.verification_criteria: Carry bandage obliquely across dorsum of foot, around back of ankle joint above malleoli, and cross back over dorsum of foot to opposite side

items.description: Repeat figure-of-eight turns overlapping the previous turn by two-thirds of bandage width with even, consistent tension
items.verification_criteria: Repeat figure-of-eight turns overlapping the previous turn by two-thirds of bandage width with even, consistent tension

items.description: Finish with two circular turns around the lower leg 5 cm above ankle joint; secure end with adhesive tape or safety pin on lateral aspect (not over bone or wound)
items.verification_criteria: Finish with two circular turns around the lower leg 5 cm above ankle joint; secure end with adhesive tape or safety pin on lateral aspect (not over bone or wound)

items.description: Assess distal neurovascular status: Check capillary refill (< 2 seconds), skin temperature, color, toe sensation and motor movement to ensure no constriction
items.verification_criteria: Assess distal neurovascular status: Check capillary refill (< 2 seconds), skin temperature, color, toe sensation and motor movement to ensure no constriction

items.description: Advise client on RICE principles (Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation) and when to report numbness/pain; document procedure
items.verification_criteria: Advise client on RICE principles (Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation) and when to report numbness/pain; document procedure

procedures.title: Non-Invasive Arterial Blood Pressure Measurement
procedures.instructions: Measure and report the arterial blood pressure of an adult client using an aneroid or mercury sphygmomanometer and acoustic stethoscope. Follow standard clinical guidelines.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A client attends the antenatal/medical clinic for a routine check-up. Demonstrate blood pressure measurement following AHA/WHO clinical standards.
equipment_list: Acoustic stethoscope with bell and diaphragm

items.description: Greet client, introduce self, verify identity, explain procedure, and confirm client has rested for 5 minutes without smoking/caffeine
items.verification_criteria: Greet client, introduce self, verify identity, explain procedure, and confirm client has rested for 5 minutes without smoking/caffeine

items.description: Clean stethoscope earpieces and diaphragm with alcohol swab; wash hands
items.verification_criteria: Clean stethoscope earpieces and diaphragm with alcohol swab; wash hands

items.description: Position client comfortably sitting with back supported, legs uncrossed, arm bare and supported at heart level (4th intercostal space)
items.verification_criteria: Position client comfortably sitting with back supported, legs uncrossed, arm bare and supported at heart level (4th intercostal space)

items.description: Select correct cuff size (bladder width 40% of arm circumference, length 80%); palpate brachial artery in antecubital fossa
items.verification_criteria: Select correct cuff size (bladder width 40% of arm circumference, length 80%); palpate brachial artery in antecubital fossa

items.description: Wrap cuff smoothly and snugly around upper arm with center of bladder over brachial artery, 2.5 cm (1 inch) above antecubital fossa
items.verification_criteria: Wrap cuff smoothly and snugly around upper arm with center of bladder over brachial artery, 2.5 cm (1 inch) above antecubital fossa

items.description: Estimate systolic pressure by palpation: Palpate radial artery, inflate cuff until pulse disappears, note pressure, add 30 mmHg, then deflate fully
items.verification_criteria: Estimate systolic pressure by palpation: Palpate radial artery, inflate cuff until pulse disappears, note pressure, add 30 mmHg, then deflate fully

items.description: Place stethoscope diaphragm/bell lightly over brachial artery pulse (not tucked under cuff edge); insert earpieces angled forward
items.verification_criteria: Place stethoscope diaphragm/bell lightly over brachial artery pulse (not tucked under cuff edge); insert earpieces angled forward

items.description: Inflate cuff rapidly to 30 mmHg above previously estimated palpated systolic level; open valve to deflate slowly at 2-3 mmHg per second
clinical_synonyms: deflate at 2 to 3 mmhg per second
items.verification_criteria: Inflate cuff rapidly to 30 mmHg above previously estimated palpated systolic level; open valve to deflate slowly at 2-3 mmHg per second

items.description: Identify Systolic Pressure: Note reading at onset of first clear tapping sound (Korotkoff Phase I)
items.verification_criteria: Identify Systolic Pressure: Note reading at onset of first clear tapping sound (Korotkoff Phase I)

items.description: Identify Diastolic Pressure: Note reading when sounds disappear completely (Korotkoff Phase V in adults); continue deflating for 10 mmHg then release fully
items.verification_criteria: Identify Diastolic Pressure: Note reading when sounds disappear completely (Korotkoff Phase V in adults); continue deflating for 10 mmHg then release fully

items.description: Remove cuff, make client comfortable, inform client of reading, wash hands, and record blood pressure immediately in client's chart
items.verification_criteria: Remove cuff, make client comfortable, inform client of reading, wash hands, and record blood pressure immediately in client's chart

procedures.title: Nurse's Role in Blood Transfusion and Reaction Management
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate and explain the nurse's responsibilities before, during, and after blood transfusion, and the immediate nursing actions in acute transfusion reactions.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A patient with severe postpartum anemia requires 1 unit of Packed Red Blood Cells. Demonstrate the pre-transfusion verification, administration protocol, monitoring, and reaction management.
equipment_list: Blood unit mockup with compatibility label
Blood administration set with micro-aggregate filter

items.description: Verify doctor's prescription for blood transfusion, check informed consent, and check IV cannula patency (18G or 20G wide-bore)
items.verification_criteria: Verify doctor's prescription for blood transfusion, check informed consent, and check IV cannula patency (18G or 20G wide-bore)

items.description: Perform two-nurse independent bedside verification: Patient name, hospital number, blood group (ABO/Rh), donor unit number, expiry date, compatibility form
items.verification_criteria: Perform two-nurse independent bedside verification: Patient name, hospital number, blood group (ABO/Rh), donor unit number, expiry date, compatibility form

items.description: Inspect blood bag: Check for clots, hemolysis, gas bubbles, turbidity, or purple discoloration; confirm transfusion starts within 30 min of leaving blood bank
items.verification_criteria: Inspect blood bag: Check for clots, hemolysis, gas bubbles, turbidity, or purple discoloration; confirm transfusion starts within 30 min of leaving blood bank

items.description: Measure and record baseline vital signs (Temperature, Pulse, Blood Pressure, Respiratory Rate) immediately before commencing transfusion
items.verification_criteria: Measure and record baseline vital signs (Temperature, Pulse, Blood Pressure, Respiratory Rate) immediately before commencing transfusion

items.description: Prime blood administration set containing in-line 170-micron filter with 0.9% Normal Saline only (never prime with dextrose or Ringer's lactate)
items.verification_criteria: Prime blood administration set containing in-line 170-micron filter with 0.9% Normal Saline only (never prime with dextrose or Ringer's lactate)

items.description: Connect blood to patient IV line; initiate transfusion slowly at 2 ml/min (20-30 drops/min or ~50 ml/hr) for the first 15 minutes
items.verification_criteria: Connect blood to patient IV line; initiate transfusion slowly at 2 ml/min (20-30 drops/min or ~50 ml/hr) for the first 15 minutes

items.description: Remain at bedside with patient for the first 15 minutes: Monitor closely for acute hemolytic, febrile, or allergic reactions
items.verification_criteria: Remain at bedside with patient for the first 15 minutes: Monitor closely for acute hemolytic, febrile, or allergic reactions

items.description: Re-check vital signs at 15 minutes: If stable, adjust infusion rate to complete unit within prescribed duration (2 to 4 hours maximum per unit)
items.verification_criteria: Re-check vital signs at 15 minutes: If stable, adjust infusion rate to complete unit within prescribed duration (2 to 4 hours maximum per unit)

items.description: State acute reaction symptoms: Chills, fever, rigor, dyspnea, lumbar/chest pain, facial flushing, urticaria, hypotension, hemoglobinuria
items.verification_criteria: State acute reaction symptoms: Chills, fever, rigor, dyspnea, lumbar/chest pain, facial flushing, urticaria, hypotension, hemoglobinuria

items.verification_criteria: Candidate greets examiner/client, introduces self, establishes rapport, and explains the objective of the counseling session

items.verification_criteria: Greet woman warmly, introduce self, explain importance of BSE for early detection of breast lumps and cancer, and establish rapport

items.verification_criteria: Examine Nipple-Areola Complex: Gently compress nipple between thumb and index finger; observe for spontaneous bloody or serous discharge

procedures.title: Tepid Sponging for Hyperpyrexia / Febrile Patient
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate the nursing procedure of tepid sponging for a patient with severe pyrexia (temperature > 39.5°C). Explain mechanisms of heat loss, cooling principles, and nursing observations.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A 5-year-old child admitted with severe malaria presents with a temperature of 40.0°C and febrile restlessness. Demonstrate tepid sponging to reduce body temperature safely without inducing shivering.
equipment_list: Basin with tepid water (temperature 28-32°C / comfortably lukewarm)

items.description: Greet patient/caregiver, introduce self, verify identity, explain procedure, explain mechanism (heat loss via evaporation and conduction), and gain consent
items.verification_criteria: Greet patient/caregiver, introduce self, verify identity, explain procedure, explain mechanism (heat loss via evaporation and conduction), and gain consent

items.description: Check baseline temperature, pulse, and respirations immediately prior to procedure
items.verification_criteria: Check baseline temperature, pulse, and respirations immediately prior to procedure

items.description: Provide privacy, close windows, turn off ceiling fans/AC to avoid rapid chilling and violent shivering
items.verification_criteria: Provide privacy, close windows, turn off ceiling fans/AC to avoid rapid chilling and violent shivering

items.description: Prepare tepid water in basin: Test temperature with bath thermometer (28°C - 32°C / 82°F - 90°F); test on inner aspect of wrist; never use cold water or alcohol
items.verification_criteria: Prepare tepid water in basin: Test temperature with bath thermometer (28°C - 32°C / 82°F - 90°F); test on inner aspect of wrist; never use cold water or alcohol

items.description: Place protective mackintosh and bath towel under patient; remove clothing and cover with light bath blanket exposing only areas being sponged
items.verification_criteria: Place protective mackintosh and bath towel under patient; remove clothing and cover with light bath blanket exposing only areas being sponged

items.description: Wring out washcloths so they are moist but not dripping; place damp washcloths on areas of large superficial blood vessels: Axillae, Groin, and Forehead (prevents cerebral congestion)

items.verification_criteria: Wring out washcloths so they are moist but not dripping; place damp washcloths on areas of large superficial blood vessels: Axillae, Groin, and Forehead (prevents cerebral congestion)

items.description: Sponge extremities and trunk systematically using gentle, long, slow downward strokes: Arms from shoulders to fingers, legs from thighs to toes (do not rub briskly, which increases metabolic heat)
items.verification_criteria: Sponge extremities and trunk systematically using gentle, long, slow downward strokes: Arms from shoulders to fingers, legs from thighs to toes (do not rub briskly, which increases metabolic heat)

items.description: Change washcloths periodically as they absorb body heat and warm up; continue sponging for 20-30 minutes
items.verification_criteria: Change washcloths periodically as they absorb body heat and warm up; continue sponging for 20-30 minutes

items.description: Observe patient continuously: If patient starts shivering, becomes cyanotic, or appears mottled, STOP tepid sponging immediately and cover warmly (shivering raises core temperature)
items.verification_criteria: Observe patient continuously: If patient starts shivering, becomes cyanotic, or appears mottled, STOP tepid sponging immediately and cover warmly (shivering raises core temperature)

items.description: Pat skin dry gently with soft towel leaving slight moisture for evaporative cooling; dress patient in light cotton clothing and cover lightly
items.verification_criteria: Pat skin dry gently with soft towel leaving slight moisture for evaporative cooling; dress patient in light cotton clothing and cover lightly

items.description: Re-check vital signs (temperature) 30 minutes post-procedure; wash hands and document pre/post temperatures and patient response
items.verification_criteria: Re-check vital signs (temperature) 30 minutes post-procedure; wash hands and document pre/post temperatures and patient response

procedures.title: Active Management of Third Stage of Labour (AMTSL)
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate the three components of Active Management of Third Stage of Labour (AMTSL) on a maternal birthing model according to ICM/FIGO and WHO guidelines. Include pharmacology of uterotonics.
procedures.scenario_prompt: You have just delivered a vigorous term neonate who is placed on the mother's abdomen for skin-to-skin care. Demonstrate the active management of the third stage of labour to prevent postpartum haemorrhage.
equipment_list: Birthing model with placenta, umbilical cord and fetus

items.description: Explain procedure to the mother, reassure her, and ensure all AMTSL supplies are ready at hand
items.verification_criteria: Explain procedure to the mother, reassure her, and ensure all AMTSL supplies are ready at hand

items.description: Component 1 (Uterotonic): Palpate mother's abdomen to rule out the presence of an undiagnosed second twin before administering uterotonic
clinical_synonyms: palpate abdomen to rule out second twin
items.verification_criteria: Component 1 (Uterotonic): Palpate mother's abdomen to rule out the presence of an undiagnosed second twin before administering uterotonic

items.description: Administer Uterotonic: Inject Oxytocin 10 IU intramuscularly into the anterolateral thigh within 1 minute of fetal delivery (or Misoprostol 600 mcg orally if oxytocin unavailable)
items.verification_criteria: Administer Uterotonic: Inject Oxytocin 10 IU intramuscularly into the anterolateral thigh within 1 minute of fetal delivery (or Misoprostol 600 mcg orally if oxytocin unavailable)

items.description: State pharmacology of Oxytocin: Onset 2-3 min IM, duration 2-3 hours; stimulates rhythmic uterine contractions; Misoprostol: E1 prostaglandin analogue, softens cervix, causes strong myometrial contractions
items.verification_criteria: State pharmacology of Oxytocin: Onset 2-3 min IM, duration 2-3 hours; stimulates rhythmic uterine contractions; Misoprostol: E1 prostaglandin analogue, softens cervix, causes strong myometrial contractions

items.description: Perform Delayed Cord Clamping: Wait 1 to 3 minutes after birth (or until cord pulsation ceases) before clamping and cutting cord, while keeping baby warm on mother's chest
items.verification_criteria: Perform Delayed Cord Clamping: Wait 1 to 3 minutes after birth (or until cord pulsation ceases) before clamping and cutting cord, while keeping baby warm on mother's chest

items.description: Clamp cord close to perineum with forceps/clamp; place non-dominant hand suprapubic just above symphysis pubis with palm facing mother's umbilicus (providing counter-traction)
items.verification_criteria: Clamp cord close to perineum with forceps/clamp; place non-dominant hand suprapubic just above symphysis pubis with palm facing mother's umbilicus (providing counter-traction)

items.description: Component 2 (Controlled Cord Traction - CCT): Wait for uterine contraction; pull cord gently downwards and outwards while pushing uterus upward and backwards with suprapubic hand
items.verification_criteria: Component 2 (Controlled Cord Traction - CCT): Wait for uterine contraction; pull cord gently downwards and outwards while pushing uterus upward and backwards with suprapubic hand

items.verification_criteria: Delivery of Placenta: As placenta emerges from vagina, catch it with both hands, gently twist and rotate in a circular motion so membranes wind into a rope and peel off intact without tearing

items.verification_criteria: Component 3 (Uterine Massage): Immediately massage the fundus through mother's abdomen until uterus is contracted hard like a cricket ball; teach mother how to self-massage fundus

items.description: Examine Placenta and Membranes: Inspect maternal cotyledons (all present, no missing lobes/succenturiate), inspect fetal surface, insertion of cord, 3 vessels, and complete membranes
items.verification_criteria: Examine Placenta and Membranes: Inspect maternal cotyledons (all present, no missing lobes/succenturiate), inspect fetal surface, insertion of cord, 3 vessels, and complete membranes

items.verification_criteria: Estimate blood loss (< 500ml), inspect perineum for tears, ensure mother is clean and comfortable, wash hands, and record details in delivery register

procedures.title: Mechanism of Normal Labour: Left Occipito-Anterior (LOA)
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate the mechanism of normal labour for Left Occipito-Anterior (LOA) position using the obstetric pelvic model and fetal doll. Name and demonstrate all seven Cardinal Movements in sequence.
procedures.scenario_prompt: You are at Station 15 with a bony female pelvis and fetal doll. Demonstrate the sequential mechanism of labour for an LOA presentation, explaining the movement of the occiput, shoulders, and trunk.
equipment_list: Fetal doll with palpable skull sutures and fontanelles

items.description: Greet examiner, introduce self, hold the bony pelvis and fetal doll correctly and orient them in true anatomical position
items.verification_criteria: Greet examiner, introduce self, hold the bony pelvis and fetal doll correctly and orient them in true anatomical position

items.description: State the Presentation, Denominator, and Position: Lie is longitudinal, Presentation is cephalic (vertex), Denominator is occiput, Position is Left Occipito-Anterior (LOA)
items.verification_criteria: State the Presentation, Denominator, and Position: Lie is longitudinal, Presentation is cephalic (vertex), Denominator is occiput, Position is Left Occipito-Anterior (LOA)

items.description: Step 1 - Descent: Head enters the pelvic brim in the right oblique diameter with suboccipito-frontal diameter (10 cm) engaging; descent continues throughout labour
items.verification_criteria: Step 1 - Descent: Head enters the pelvic brim in the right oblique diameter with suboccipito-frontal diameter (10 cm) engaging; descent continues throughout labour

items.verification_criteria: Step 2 - Flexion: As descending head meets resistance of soft tissues / pelvic floor, increased flexion occurs, substituting suboccipito-bregmatic diameter (9.5 cm)

items.description: Step 3 - Internal Rotation of the Head: Occiput reaches pelvic floor and rotates 1/8th of a circle (45 degrees) anteriorly to lie under the symphysis pubis (anteroposterior diameter of outlet)
items.verification_criteria: Step 3 - Internal Rotation of the Head: Occiput reaches pelvic floor and rotates 1/8th of a circle (45 degrees) anteriorly to lie under the symphysis pubis (anteroposterior diameter of outlet)

items.verification_criteria: Step 4 - Crowning: The widest diameter of the fetal head (biparietal 9.5 cm) stretches the vulval outlet without head receding between contractions

items.verification_criteria: Step 5 - Extension: Nape of the neck pivots under the subpubic arch; with extension, sinciput, face, and chin sweep over the perineum and head is born

items.verification_criteria: Step 6 - Restitution: Head rotates 1/8th of a circle back to the left to align with the shoulders which are engaging in the left oblique diameter of the brim

items.description: Step 7 - Internal Rotation of Shoulders: Anterior shoulder reaches pelvic floor and rotates 1/8th of a circle anteriorly to lie behind symphysis pubis; causes External Rotation of the head (another 1/8th circle)
items.verification_criteria: Step 7 - Internal Rotation of Shoulders: Anterior shoulder reaches pelvic floor and rotates 1/8th of a circle anteriorly to lie behind symphysis pubis; causes External Rotation of the head (another 1/8th circle)

items.verification_criteria: Step 8 - Lateral Flexion: Anterior shoulder is born under symphysis pubis, followed by posterior shoulder over perineum; remaining body is born by lateral flexion

procedures.title: Infiltration and Performance of Mediolateral Episiotomy
procedures.instructions: Demonstrate local anaesthetic perineal infiltration and cutting of a mediolateral episiotomy on the perineal model. State indications, timing, structures cut, and protection of fetal head.

items.verification_criteria: State indications for episiotomy: Rigid perineum, fetal distress in 2nd stage, instrumental delivery (forceps/vacuum), shoulder dystocia, preterm delivery

items.verification_criteria: Explain procedure to mother, obtain informed consent, ensure bladder is empty, clean perineum with antiseptic, and don sterile gloves

items.verification_criteria: Introduce needle at posterior fourchette; infiltrate 10ml of 1% Lignocaine along the planned mediolateral incision line in a fan-shaped manner, aspirating before injection to avoid intravascular entry

items.verification_criteria: Allow 2-3 minutes for anaesthetic effect (unless acute fetal distress); test for analgesia by pinching gently with forceps

items.verification_criteria: Position fingers: Keep two fingers inside vagina depressing vaginal wall to protect baby's head from scissors blades

items.verification_criteria: Cut Mediolateral Episiotomy: Place one blade of blunt-ended episiotomy scissors inside vagina and other outside; make a single clean, decisive cut 3 to 4 cm long at 45° angle towards the ischial tuberosity

procedures.title: Abdominal Palpation: Leopold's Maneuvers for Fetal Lie and Presentation

procedures.title: Health Education on Common Minor Disorders of Pregnancy and Management
procedures.instructions: Counsel an antenatal client experiencing common minor discomforts of pregnancy. Explain causes and non-pharmacological and pharmacological management of morning sickness, heartburn, constipation, backache, and varicose veins.
procedures.scenario_prompt: A 22-year-old primigravida at 14 weeks gestation complains of distressing morning sickness, heartburn, and constipation. Deliver structured reassuring counseling on managing these common discomforts.

items.description: Greet client warmly, introduce self, establish rapport, explain that minor disorders are common physiological adaptations, and reassure her
items.verification_criteria: Greet client warmly, introduce self, establish rapport, explain that minor disorders are common physiological adaptations, and reassure her

items.description: Morning Sickness (Nausea & Vomiting) - Cause: Rising hCG and estrogen levels, altered carbohydrate metabolism; peak at 8-12 weeks
items.verification_criteria: Morning Sickness (Nausea & Vomiting) - Cause: Rising hCG and estrogen levels, altered carbohydrate metabolism; peak at 8-12 weeks

items.description: Morning Sickness - Management: Eat small, frequent bland meals (dry toast, crackers before rising from bed), avoid spicy/greasy foods, drink fluids between meals, ginger tea, Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine)
items.verification_criteria: Morning Sickness - Management: Eat small, frequent bland meals (dry toast, crackers before rising from bed), avoid spicy/greasy foods, drink fluids between meals, ginger tea, Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine)

items.description: Heartburn (Pyrosis) - Cause: Progesterone relaxes lower esophageal sphincter, coupled with upward displacement of stomach by gravid uterus
items.verification_criteria: Heartburn (Pyrosis) - Cause: Progesterone relaxes lower esophageal sphincter, coupled with upward displacement of stomach by gravid uterus

items.description: Heartburn - Management: Eat small frequent meals, avoid lying down immediately after meals (wait 2 hours), sleep with head elevated on pillows, avoid fatty/acidic foods, use antacids if prescribed
items.verification_criteria: Heartburn - Management: Eat small frequent meals, avoid lying down immediately after meals (wait 2 hours), sleep with head elevated on pillows, avoid fatty/acidic foods, use antacids if prescribed

items.description: Constipation - Cause: Progesterone slows gastrointestinal motility, increased water reabsorption in colon, oral iron supplementation, pressure of uterus on rectum
items.verification_criteria: Constipation - Cause: Progesterone slows gastrointestinal motility, increased water reabsorption in colon, oral iron supplementation, pressure of uterus on rectum

items.description: Constipation - Management: Increase dietary fiber (whole grains, vegetables, fruits, beans), drink 2.5-3 liters of water daily, gentle regular exercise (walking), avoid straining; stool softeners if needed
items.verification_criteria: Constipation - Management: Increase dietary fiber (whole grains, vegetables, fruits, beans), drink 2.5-3 liters of water daily, gentle regular exercise (walking), avoid straining; stool softeners if needed

items.description: Backache and Varicose Veins - Management: Good posture, low-heeled shoes, pelvic tilt exercises, supportive maternity belt, avoid prolonged standing, elevate legs when sitting, wear compression stockings

items.description: Differentiate minor disorders from red flag danger signs (hyperemesis gravidarum with ketonuria, severe epigastric pain of preeclampsia); answer questions and document counseling
